name: contextual-ai
label: Contextual AI
description: Integrate with Contextual AI to automate document processing and AI workflows

baseUrl.label: Base URL
baseUrl.description: API base URL (leave blank for default). The host only, without https://, such as name.example.com.

query_agent.label: Query Agent
query_agent.description: Send a message to a Contextual AI agent and get a response

message.label: Message
message.description: The message to send to the agent

conversationId.label: Conversation ID
conversationId.description: Optional conversation ID to continue an existing conversation (leave empty for new conversation)

includeRetrievalContent.label: Include Retrieval Content
includeRetrievalContent.description: Include the text of retrieved contents in the response

generate.label: Generate Text
generate.description: Generate text using Contextual AI's Grounded Language Model

prompt.label: Prompt
prompt.description: The text prompt to generate a response for

model.label: Model Version
model.description: The version of Contextual's GLM to use

knowledge.label: Knowledge Sources
knowledge.description: Optional knowledge sources to ground the generation (leave empty for general generation)

systemPrompt.label: System Prompt
systemPrompt.description: Optional system instructions for the model

maxTokens.label: Max Tokens
maxTokens.description: Maximum number of tokens to generate (default: 1024)

temperature.label: Temperature
temperature.description: Sampling temperature (0.0 to 1.0, lower = more focused, higher = more creative)

avoidCommentary.label: Avoid Commentary
avoidCommentary.description: Avoid providing additional conversational commentary not grounded in context
